sub.en: Look at the phrases. Which are softer, and which put you in their place?

items.q: ___ you, I’d take the job.
items.why: “If I were you” is a fixed phrase — it keeps were for every person. It is the strongest way to give advice without ordering.

items.q: You ___ take it easy for a few days.
You ___ to see a doctor about it.
items.why: ought TO + verb; should + verb with no “to”. They mean almost the same.

items.q: ___ you talk to her about it?
It’s a good idea ___ your windows closed at night.
I don’t think you ___ feel bad about it.
items.why: English puts the negative on “think”, as with “I don’t think it will”.

items.q: The doctor was clear: you ___ lift anything heavy for two weeks.
items.why: RECYCLED from Lesson 23: the doctor forbids it, so mustn’t — stronger than shouldn’t, which is only advice.

items.q: When you ___ home, have a warm drink.
items.why: RECYCLED from Lesson 26: the time clause takes the present.

tts: How can I help you? — I’m having real trouble sleeping just now.
OK, first of all, you should try to reduce caffeine or other stimulants. — Right, I can probably drink a bit less coffee. Anything else?
It’s also a good idea to keep calm during the evening. No violent TV programmes. — OK. I won’t watch any. And what about at bedtime?
Well, just before you go to bed, have a bath or drink some warm milk.

acts.title: Application for the position of Junior Analyst
text: I am writing to apply for the position of Junior Analyst advertised on your website on 3 September.

I am currently a data assistant at Kaspi Retail, where I have worked for two years. In that role I prepare the weekly sales figures for four regions and I have built the reporting template the team now uses. Before that I completed a degree in economics at KIMEP.
I am applying because the vacancy asks for someone who can both handle the numbers and explain them. That is the part of my present job I do best, and it is the part I do least often.
I am available for interview at any time and I could start at four weeks’ notice.
I attach my CV and the names of two referees. Please let me know if you need anything further.
I look forward to hearing from you.

items.q: What is she applying for?
Where did she see the vacancy?
How long has she been in her present job?
What did she build?
Why is she applying?
o: the job needs numbers and explanation

items.q: Why “Yours sincerely” and not “Yours faithfully”?

sub.en: These are the moves in the covering letter. Put them in the order Aigul used.

items.a: Say which job and where you saw it
Give one concrete thing you have done
Say why this job and not another
Say what you have attached and close

write.q: Write a covering letter for a real or invented job: 8–10 lines. Follow the model’s six moves, and use at least four of its phrases: I am writing to apply for… / I am currently… / I am available for… / I attach… / I look forward to hearing from you / Yours sincerely.
write.model: Dear Mr Aliyev, I am writing to apply for the position of English teacher advertised on your website on 14 August. I am currently a teaching assistant at School 42, where I have worked for three years. In that role I take two evening groups of my own and I wrote the placement test the school still uses. Before that I completed a degree in philology at Al-Farabi. I am applying because the vacancy asks for somebody who can teach adults and design materials, and those are the two parts of my present job I do best. I am available for interview at any time and I could start in October. I attach my CV and the names of two referees. I look forward to hearing from you. Yours sincerely, Marat Zhaksybek

speak.q: Give advice out loud in four different ways to a friend deciding whether to move city for a job: use If I were you, You should, Why don’t you, and It’s a good idea to. Then say one thing they mustn’t do.
speak.model: If I were you, I’d go and look at the place first. You should ask them for a week to decide. Why don’t you write both columns down? It’s a good idea to talk to somebody who already works there. But you mustn’t sign anything before you’ve seen the contract.
